engine: milvus standalone v2.5.10 (etcd + MinIO + Milvus, real segment engine)
method: exact float32 byte-search of MinIO object store (segment binlogs), live-filler positive control
verdict: DURABLE for realistic small-ratio deletes: compaction threshold not met at 0.16% -> no segment rewrite; GC does not touch live segment. Deleted vectors persist in MinIO binlog. Joins Chroma in durable bucket.
caveat: high delete-ratio would trigger compaction and likely purge; get_compaction_state had a client bug but compaction would not merge at this ratio regardless.
